title: FFE
text: Models a feed-forward equalizer, 1 input, 1 output, {Tap Spacing} sets Fractional taps for sub-symbol equalization control; {Mode} sets the fFE operating mode, {Tap weights} sets the fFE tap weights, {Normalize} and {Visualize Response} plots FFE FIR filter. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Tap Spacing
params.values: Fractional taps for sub-symbol equalization control T-spaced (default) | T/2-spaced | T/4-spaced

params.name: Visualize Response
params.values: Plot FFE FIR filter response button
